fields.name: requested_effective_date
fields.normalization: A valid calendar date; no past or future date rule.

fields.name: operations_description
fields.normalization: Preserve the source meaning; no eligibility rule.

fields.name: declared_vehicle_count
fields.normalization: An applicant-stated count from the email or PDF.

fields.name: operating_radius_miles
fields.normalization: Numeric miles; 150 is allowed and 150.1 is flagged.

fields.name: hazardous_materials
fields.normalization: Explicit Yes / true or No / false; absence is not No.

fields.name: schedule_vehicle_count
fields.normalization: Derived from nonblank vehicle records after the CSV header.

evidence.absence: Record the inspected source set for missing fields or absent documents. Do not invent a quotation for absent information.

conflicts: If explicit normalized values in the email and PDF disagree, keep alternatives and evidence, set the unresolved field value to null with state CONFLICT, and do not choose a preferred source. Missing mentions are not conflicting values.
csv: Header is vehicle_id,vin,year,make,model. Count nonblank data rows; header excluded. No VIN decoding, deduplication or VIN validation is required.
manual_corrections: Keep original evidence and conflict notes. A correction may resolve the effective value used by the rules, marked as a human override.
output_design: Your internal JSON schema and API design are your choice. These field names and semantics form the shared evaluation contract.
